hazards.location_in_image: Entire visible stretch of the roadway.

hazards.name: Narrow Sidewalk Obstructions
hazards.description: Trash bins and building steps narrow the effective walking width of the sidewalk.
hazards.location_in_image: Left side of the image on the sidewalk area.

interventions.title: Speed Humps or Cushions

interventions.title: Leading Pedestrian Interval (LPI)
interventions.description: Adjust signal timing to provide pedestrians with a 3-7 second head start before the parallel vehicle traffic receives a green light.

interventions.description: Encourage the restoration of windows or active uses on the ground floor to improve the pedestrian experience through increased natural surveillance.
